import { KINDS, type Field, type FormState } from './form';
import { initialValue } from './schema';

/** The form as data: rows of fields, each with the settings its kind has. */
export function toJson(form: FormState, names: Map<string, string>): string {
  const fieldJson = (field: Field) => {
    const has = (setting: string) => (KINDS[field.kind].settings as string[]).includes(setting);
    return {
      type: field.kind,
      name: names.get(field.id),
      label: field.label,
      description: field.description || undefined,
      placeholder: has('placeholder') && field.placeholder ? field.placeholder : undefined,
      required: has('required') ? field.required : undefined,
      options: has('options') ? field.options.map((option) => option.label) : undefined,
      multiple: has('multiple') ? field.multiple : undefined,
      min: has('range') ? (field.min ?? undefined) : undefined,
      max: has('range') || has('stars') ? (field.max ?? undefined) : undefined,
    };
  };
  const data = { title: form.title, description: form.description, rows: form.rows.map((row) => row.fields.map(fieldJson)) };
  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

/** A string literal, an HTML text, an attribute: what the user typed, escaped for each. */
const text = (value: string) => `'${value.replaceAll('\\', '\\\\').replaceAll("'", "\\'")}'`;
const html = (value: string) => value.replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('"', '"');
const attr = (name: string, value: string | null | undefined) => (value ? ` ${name}="${html(value)}"` : '');
const items = (field: Field) => `:items="[${field.options.map((option) => text(option.label)).join(', ')}]"`;

/** The rule of `schema.ts`'s `ruleOf`, as code. */
function ruleCode(field: Field): string | null {
  const { required, min, max } = field;
  switch (field.kind) {
    case 'text':
    case 'textarea':
      return required ? `z.string().min(1, 'Required')` : 'z.string()';
    case 'email':
      return required ? `z.email('Enter a valid email')` : `z.email('Enter a valid email').or(z.literal(''))`;
    case 'number': {
      let rule = `z.number({ error: 'Required' })`;
      if (min != null) rule += `.min(${min}, 'At least ${min}')`;
      if (max != null) rule += `.max(${max}, 'At most ${max}')`;
      return required ? rule : `${rule}.nullish()`;
    }
    case 'select':
      return required ? `z.string({ error: 'Pick an option' })` : 'z.string().optional()';
    case 'choice':
      if (field.multiple) return required ? `z.array(z.string()).min(1, 'Pick at least one')` : 'z.array(z.string())';
      return required ? `z.string({ error: 'Pick an option' })` : 'z.string().optional()';
    case 'checkbox':
      return required ? `z.literal(true, { error: 'Required' })` : 'z.boolean()';
    case 'switch':
      return 'z.boolean()';
    case 'rating':
      return required ? `z.number().min(1, 'Pick a rating')` : 'z.number()';
    case 'date':
      return required ? `z.custom((value) => value != null, 'Pick a date')` : 'z.unknown()';
    case 'file':
      return required ? `z.instanceof(File, { error: 'Attach a file' })` : 'z.instanceof(File).nullish()';
    case 'heading':
      return null;
  }
}

/** The control of `FieldView.vue`, as code. */
function controlCode(field: Field, name: string): string {
  const model = `v-model="state.${name}"`;
  const placeholder = attr('placeholder', field.placeholder);
  switch (field.kind) {
    case 'text':
      return `<UInput ${model}${placeholder} class="w-full" />`;
    case 'textarea':
      return `<UTextarea ${model}${placeholder} :rows="3" autoresize class="w-full" />`;
    case 'email':
      return `<UInput ${model} type="email" icon="i-lucide-at-sign"${placeholder} class="w-full" />`;
    case 'number': {
      const bounds = `${field.min != null ? ` :min="${field.min}"` : ''}${field.max != null ? ` :max="${field.max}"` : ''}`;
      return `<UInputNumber ${model}${bounds}${placeholder} class="w-full" />`;
    }
    case 'date':
      return `<UInputDate ${model} class="w-full" />`;
    case 'select':
      return `<USelect ${model} ${items(field)}${placeholder} class="w-full" />`;
    case 'choice':
      return `<${field.multiple ? 'UCheckboxGroup' : 'URadioGroup'} ${model} ${items(field)} />`;
    case 'checkbox':
    case 'switch': {
      const tag = field.kind === 'checkbox' ? 'UCheckbox' : 'USwitch';
      return `<${tag} ${model}${attr('label', field.label)}${attr('description', field.description)}${field.required ? ' required' : ''} />`;
    }
    case 'rating':
      return `<UInputRating ${model} :length="${field.max ?? 5}" />`;
    case 'file':
      return `<UFileUpload ${model} icon="i-lucide-upload"${attr('label', field.placeholder)} class="min-h-28 w-full" />`;
    case 'heading':
      return '';
  }
}

function fieldCode(field: Field, name: string | undefined, indent: string): string {
  if (field.kind === 'heading') {
    return [
      `${indent}<div>`,
      `${indent}  <h3 class="text-base font-semibold text-highlighted">${html(field.label)}</h3>`,
      ...(field.description ? [`${indent}  <p class="text-sm text-muted">${html(field.description)}</p>`] : []),
      `${indent}</div>`,
    ].join('\n');
  }
  // A checkbox and a switch carry their label themselves.
  const labelled = field.kind !== 'checkbox' && field.kind !== 'switch';
  const head = labelled
    ? `${attr('label', field.label)}${attr('description', field.description)}${attr('name', name)}${field.required ? ' required' : ''}`
    : attr('name', name);
  return [`${indent}<UFormField${head}>`, `${indent}  ${controlCode(field, name!)}`, `${indent}</UFormField>`].join('\n');
}

export function toVue(form: FormState, names: Map<string, string>): string {
  const fields = form.rows.flatMap((row) => row.fields);
  const rules = fields.flatMap((field) => {
    const rule = ruleCode(field);
    return rule ? [`  ${names.get(field.id)}: ${rule},`] : [];
  });
  const values = fields.flatMap((field) => {
    const value = initialValue(field);
    const code = typeof value === 'string' ? text(value) : JSON.stringify(value);
    return field.kind === 'heading' || value === undefined ? [] : [`  ${names.get(field.id)}: ${code},`];
  });

  // A row of several fields is a grid: one column on phones, side by side from `sm` up.
  const rows = form.rows.map((row) => {
    if (row.fields.length === 1) return fieldCode(row.fields[0]!, names.get(row.fields[0]!.id), '    ');
    const columns = `sm:grid-cols-${row.fields.length}`;
    const inner = row.fields.map((field) => fieldCode(field, names.get(field.id), '      '));
    return [`    <div class="grid gap-4 ${columns}">`, ...inner, '    </div>'].join('\n');
  });

  return `<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive } from 'vue';
import * as z from 'zod';
import type { FormSubmitEvent } from '@nuxt/ui';

const schema = z.object({
${rules.join('\n')}
});

type Schema = z.output<typeof schema>;

const state = reactive<Partial<Schema>>({
${values.join('\n')}
});

function onSubmit(event: FormSubmitEvent<Schema>) {
  console.log(event.data);
}
</script>

<template>
  <UForm :schema="schema" :state="state" novalidate class="flex flex-col gap-5" @submit="onSubmit">
    <div>
      <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-highlighted">${html(form.title)}</h2>
      <p class="text-sm text-muted">${html(form.description)}</p>
    </div>
${rows.join('\n')}
    <UButton type="submit" label="Submit" />
  </UForm>
</template>
`;
}

const selected = computed(() => form.selected?.id === props.field.id);

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || status.value !== 'idle') return;
  if (event.key === 'Enter') form.select(props.field.id);
  else if (event.key === 'Delete' || event.key === 'Backspace') form.remove(props.field.id);
  else if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'd') form.duplicate(props.field.id);
  else return;
  event.preventDefault();
}

    multiple: false,
    min: null,
    max: null,
    ...KINDS[kind].defaults,
    ...patch,
    kind,

export const rowList = (rowId: string) => `row:${rowId}`;
/** An empty list that makes a new row: above a row, or after the last one (`null`). */
export const newRowList = (beforeRowId: string | null) => `new:${beforeRowId ?? 'end'}`;
/** The trash, a plain drop target. */
export const TRASH = 'trash';

/** `First name` → `firstName`: the key of a field's answer. */
const camelCase = (text: string) =>
  text
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, ' ')
    .trim()
    .split(' ')
    .map((word, index) => (index ? word[0]!.toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase() : word.toLowerCase()))
    .join('')
    .replace(/^\d/, '_$&');

const HISTORY = 100;

/**
 * The form, and the only place that changes it. The lists read it through getters and never
 * write it themselves: each drop calls `drop`, which applies the drop's `result`, so every
 * change goes through `commit`, and Undo can take it back.
 */
export function createForm() {
  const state = reactive<FormState>(sample());
  const selectedId = ref<string | null>(null);

  const fields = computed(() => state.rows.flatMap((row) => row.fields));
  const selected = computed(() => fields.value.find((field) => field.id === selectedId.value) ?? null);
  /** A selected field that is gone (trashed, undone) is no longer selected. */
  const forgetGone = () => {
    if (!selected.value) selectedId.value = null;
  };

  /** The key of every field's answer, unique: `email`, `email2`… Headings have none. */
  const names = computed(() => {
    const result = new Map<string, string>();
    const taken = new Set<string>();
    for (const field of fields.value) {
      if (field.kind === 'heading') continue;
      const base = camelCase(field.label) || field.kind;
      let name = base;
      for (let n = 2; taken.has(name); n++) name = `${base}${n}`;
      taken.add(name);
      result.set(field.id, name);
    }
    return result;
  });

  // ── History: snapshots of the whole form, as JSON. Edits of one property in a row
  // (typing a label) share a key and make a single step.
  const past = ref<string[]>([]);
  const future = ref<string[]>([]);
  let lastKey: string | null = null;
  const snapshot = () => JSON.stringify(state);
  const restore = (json: string) => Object.assign(state, JSON.parse(json) as FormState);

  function commit(change: () => void, key: string | null = null) {
    if (!key || key !== lastKey) {
      past.value = [...past.value.slice(1 - HISTORY), snapshot()];
      future.value = [];
    }
    lastKey = key;
    change();
    // A row whose last field left is gone.
    state.rows = state.rows.filter((row) => row.fields.length > 0);
  }

  function undo() {
    const previous = past.value.at(-1);
    if (!previous) return;
    future.value = [...future.value, snapshot()];
    past.value = past.value.slice(0, -1);
    restore(previous);
    lastKey = null;
    forgetGone();
  }

  function redo() {
    const next = future.value.at(-1);
    if (!next) return;
    past.value = [...past.value, snapshot()];
    future.value = future.value.slice(0, -1);
    restore(next);
    lastKey = null;
    forgetGone();
  }

  // ── Changes

  const rowOf = (fieldId: string) => state.rows.find((row) => row.fields.some((field) => field.id === fieldId));

  /**
   * A drop into any list of the form: its new arrays, by list id. A drop on a "new row"
   * list puts the fields in a row of their own there.
   */
  function apply(result: ReadonlyMap<Key, unknown[]>) {
    commit(() => {
      const created: [before: string, fields: Field[]][] = [];
      for (const [list, items] of result) {
        const [type, id] = String(list).split(':') as [string, string];
        if (list === ROWS) state.rows = items as Row[];
        else if (type === 'row') state.rows.find((row) => row.id === id)!.fields = items as Field[];
        else if (type === 'new' && items.length) created.push([id, items as Field[]]);
      }
      for (const [before, items] of created) {
        const index = state.rows.findIndex((row) => row.id === before);
        state.rows.splice(index < 0 ? state.rows.length : index, 0, row(...items));
      }
    });
  }

  /** `onDrop` of every list: applies the drop, and selects a field that was just added. */
  function drop(event: SortableDropEvent<unknown>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    apply(event.result);
    if (event.mode === 'copy') selectedId.value = (event.items[0] as Field).id;
    forgetGone();
  }

  function add(kind: FieldKind) {
    const field = createField(kind);
    commit(() => state.rows.push(row(field)));
    selectedId.value = field.id;
  }

  function update(id: string, patch: Partial<Field>, key?: keyof Field | `option:${string}`) {
    const field = fields.value.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (field) commit(() => Object.assign(field, patch), key ? `${id}:${key}` : null);
  }

  function remove(id: string) {
    const from = rowOf(id);
    if (!from) return;
    commit(() => (from.fields = from.fields.filter((field) => field.id !== id)));
    if (selectedId.value === id) selectedId.value = null;
  }

  /** The copy goes next to the field, or below it when its row is full. */
  function duplicate(id: string) {
    const from = rowOf(id);
    const field = from?.fields.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!from || !field) return;
    const copy = cloneField(field);
    commit(() => {
      if (from.fields.length < MAX_COLUMNS) from.fields.splice(from.fields.indexOf(field) + 1, 0, copy);
      else state.rows.splice(state.rows.indexOf(from) + 1, 0, row(copy));
    });
    selectedId.value = copy.id;
  }

  /** The form's title or description: typing in one is a single step of Undo. */
  const editHeader = (patch: Partial<Pick<FormState, 'title' | 'description'>>) =>
    commit(() => Object.assign(state, patch), Object.keys(patch)[0]);

  /** A place in the lists, in words, for screen readers. */
  function describe({ list, index, length }: AnnouncedPosition): string {
    const [type, id] = String(list).split(':') as [string, string];
    const rowNumber = (rowId: string) => state.rows.findIndex((item) => item.id === rowId) + 1;
    if (list === ROWS) return `row ${index + 1} of ${length}`;
    if (type === 'row') return length > 1 ? `row ${rowNumber(id)}, column ${index + 1} of ${length}` : `row ${rowNumber(id)}`;
    if (type === 'new') return id === 'end' ? 'a new row at the end' : `a new row above row ${rowNumber(id)}`;
    return 'the palette';
  }

  // Reactive: components read `form.selected`, `form.canUndo`… without `.value`.
  return reactive({
    state,
    fields,
    names,
    selected,
    select: (id: string | null) => (selectedId.value = id),
    canUndo: computed(() => past.value.length > 0),
    canRedo: computed(() => future.value.length > 0),
    undo,
    redo,
    drop,
    add,
    update,
    remove,
    duplicate,
    editHeader,
    describe,
  });
}

export type Form = ReturnType<typeof createForm>;
export const FORM: InjectionKey<Form> = Symbol('form');
export const useForm = () => inject(FORM)!;

import { computed, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import type { FormSubmitEvent } from '@nuxt/ui';
import FieldView from './FieldView.vue';
import { useForm } from './form';
import { initialValue, printable, schemaOf } from './schema';

/** The form as people will fill it: a real `UForm`, validated by a Zod schema made from the fields. */
const form = useForm();

const rows = computed(() =>
  form.state.rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    fields: row.fields.map((field) => ({ field, name: form.names.get(field.id) ?? field.id })),
  })),
);
const schema = computed(() => schemaOf(form.fields, form.names));

const blank = () => Object.fromEntries(rows.value.flatMap((row) => row.fields.map(({ field, name }) => [name, initialValue(field)])));
const state = reactive<Record<string, unknown>>(blank());

/** What the last submit sent, as JSON. */
const sent = ref<string | null>(null);
const onSubmit = (event: FormSubmitEvent<Record<string, unknown>>) => (sent.value = printable(event.data));
const again = () => {
  Object.assign(state, blank());
  sent.value = null;
};

// Static class names, so Tailwind finds them. A row's fields stack in a narrow builder (the
// builder is the container) and sit side by side from `@lg` up.
const COLUMNS = ['', '', '@lg:grid-cols-2', '@lg:grid-cols-3'];
</script>

import * as z from 'zod';
import type { Field } from './form';

/**
 * The preview's validation: a Zod schema made from the fields, which `UForm` takes as it is.
 * `export.ts` writes the same rules as code.
 */
function ruleOf(field: Field): z.ZodType | null {
  const { required, min, max } = field;
  switch (field.kind) {
    case 'text':
    case 'textarea':
      return required ? z.string().min(1, 'Required') : z.string();
    case 'email': {
      const email = z.email('Enter a valid email');
      return required ? email : email.or(z.literal(''));
    }
    case 'number': {
      let number = z.number({ error: 'Required' });
      if (min != null) number = number.min(min, `At least ${min}`);
      if (max != null) number = number.max(max, `At most ${max}`);
      return required ? number : number.nullish();
    }
    case 'select':
      return required ? z.string({ error: 'Pick an option' }) : z.string().optional();
    case 'choice':
      if (field.multiple) return required ? z.array(z.string()).min(1, 'Pick at least one') : z.array(z.string());
      return required ? z.string({ error: 'Pick an option' }) : z.string().optional();
    case 'checkbox':
      return required ? z.literal(true, { error: 'Required' }) : z.boolean();
    case 'switch':
      return z.boolean();
    case 'rating':
      return required ? z.number().min(1, 'Pick a rating') : z.number();
    case 'date':
      return required ? z.custom((value) => value != null, 'Pick a date') : z.unknown();
    case 'file':
      return required ? z.instanceof(File, { error: 'Attach a file' }) : z.instanceof(File).nullish();
    case 'heading':
      return null;
  }
}

export function schemaOf(fields: Field[], names: Map<string, string>) {
  const shape: Record<string, z.ZodType> = {};
  for (const field of fields) {
    const rule = ruleOf(field);
    if (rule) shape[names.get(field.id)!] = rule;
  }
  return z.object(shape);
}

/** What each control starts with: empty text, no choice, unticked. */
export function initialValue(field: Field): unknown {
  switch (field.kind) {
    case 'text':
    case 'textarea':
    case 'email':
      return '';
    case 'choice':
      return field.multiple ? [] : undefined;
    case 'checkbox':
    case 'switch':
      return false;
    case 'rating':
      return 0;
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

/** Submitted values as JSON: a file by its name, a date as `2026-06-12`. */
export const printable = (data: unknown) =>
  JSON.stringify(
    data,
    (_key, value: unknown) => {
      if (value instanceof File) return value.name;
      if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'calendar' in value) return String(value);
      return value;
    },
    2,
  );

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { TRASH } from './form';

/**
 * Covers the palette while a field of the form is dragged: drop it here to delete it. It
 * takes the form's fields only (their type is their group's name), not new ones from the
 * palette, nor rows. `source.remove()` takes the field out of its row: the row's `onDrop`
 * runs, and the form records the change, so Undo brings the field back.
 */
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
const { isOver, isAccepting } = makeDroppable(el, {
  id: TRASH,
  accept: 'fields',
  onDrop: (event) => {
    // An Alt-drag carries a copy: there is nothing to delete.
    if (event.mode !== 'copy') event.source?.remove();
  },
});
</script>

      isAccepting ? 'bg-default/85' : 'pointer-events-none scale-95 opacity-0',
      isOver ? 'border-error bg-error/10 text-error' : 'border-error/40 text-muted',
